# Runtime configuration

Runtime knobs of the Java services, as proto3 JSON (snake_case keys). The same document is used in a scenario's `scoring:` / `model_server:` sections, on the services' admin HTTP endpoints (`POST /admin/config`) and on the compacted `bench.control` topic, so changes made live from the console's control drawer use exactly this schema.

Every run sends a complete config: fields a scenario leaves out are filled from the defaults below, so nothing leaks from one run into the next.

## Latency distributions (all values milliseconds)

| Field | Type | # | Description |
|---|---|---|---|

| `min_ms` | `double` | 3 |  |
| `max_ms` | `double` | 4 |  |

### `LogNormal`

Parameterised by median and p99 (more intuitive than mu/sigma); optional hard cap.

| Field | Type | # | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `median_ms` | `double` | 1 |  |
| `p99_ms` | `double` | 2 |  |
| `max_ms` | `double` | 3 |  |

### `Bimodal`

Mostly-lognormal body plus an occasional uniform tail spike (GC pause, retransmit, ...).

| Field | Type | # | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `median_ms` | `double` | 1 |  |
| `p99_ms` | `double` | 2 |  |
| `tail_prob` | `double` | 3 |  |
| `tail_min_ms` | `double` | 4 |  |
| `tail_max_ms` | `double` | 5 |  |

### `Empirical`

Piecewise-linear inverse CDF: quantiles[i] in [0,1] ascending, ms[i] the value at that quantile.

| Field | Type | # | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `quantiles` | `repeated double` | 1 |  |
| `ms` | `repeated double` | 2 |  |

## Mock model server (KServe v2) capacity model

### `ModelServerConfig`

| Field | Type | # | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `service_time` | `LatencyDist` | 1 | `{"lognormal": {"median_ms": 8, "p99_ms": 25}}` | service time of one batch (base) |
| `per_item_us` | `double` | 2 | `0` | extra compute per item in a batch |
| `workers` | `uint32` | 3 | `0` | concurrent batches (GPU instances / CUDA streams); 0 = unlimited |
| `max_batch` | `uint32` | 4 | `1` | dynamic batching: max items per batch (1 = off) |
| `max_queue_delay_us` | `uint32` | 5 | `0` | dynamic batching: max wait to fill a batch |
| `max_queue` | `uint32` | 6 | `0` | queued requests beyond this are rejected (0 = unbounded) |
| `model_version` | `string` | 7 |  |  |
| `weights_path` | `string` | 8 |  | mock model server: load these proxy weights (hot redeploy); "" = keep |

### `OnDeadline` (enum)

| Value | Number | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `FALLBACK_RULES` | 0 | rules-only decision, flagged degraded |
| `TIMEOUT` | 1 | fail the request (sync) / emit nothing until done (async) |
| `PROVISIONAL_THEN_ASYNC` | 2 | answer provisionally now, publish final decision later |

### `AuditFailure` (enum)

| Value | Number | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `SPOOL_LOCAL` | 0 | append to local WAL, replay later, never block payments |
| `FAIL_CLOSED` | 1 | decline when the audit record cannot be made durable |

## Scoring orchestrator (gateway + Flink inline)

### `ScoringConfig`

| Field | Type | # | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `version` | `string` | 1 |  |  |
| `budget_ms` | `uint32` | 2 | `100` | overall hot-path budget (deadline from ingest) |
| `feature_deadline_ms` | `uint32` | 3 | `30` | per-stage deadline for feature lookup |
| `model_deadline_ms` | `uint32` | 4 | `80` | per-stage deadline for model call |
| `on_deadline` | `OnDeadline` | 5 | `"FALLBACK_RULES"` |  |
| `feature_lookup_delay` | `LatencyDist` | 6 | `{}` | injected on top of the real store, per lookup |
| `model_extra_delay` | `LatencyDist` | 7 | `{}` | injected client-side before the model call |
| `feature_source` | `string` | 8 | `"redis"` | "redis" \| "mock" |
| `review_threshold` | `float` | 9 |  | > 0 overrides the rule set's thresholds.review (live tuning) |
| `decline_threshold` | `float` | 10 |  | > 0 overrides the rule set's thresholds.decline |
| `microbatch_window_us` | `uint32` | 11 | `0` | 0 = one RPC per event |
| `microbatch_max` | `uint32` | 12 | `0` |  |
| `hedge_after_ms` | `uint32` | 13 | `0` | > 0: a model call unanswered after this sends a duplicate on another |
| `feature_sample_permille` | `uint32` | 14 | `1000` | channel; the first response wins (tail cut at the cost of extra load) decisions carrying the full feature vector (default all) |
| `rule_set_yaml` | `string` | 16 |  | full rule set (hot reload) |
| `audit_on_failure` | `AuditFailure` | 17 | `"SPOOL_LOCAL"` |  |
| `self_inclusion` | `bool` | 18 | `true` | add current event to online-store aggregates (gateway) |
| `echo` | `bool` | 19 | `false` | calibration: decide immediately, no features/model |
| `challenge_threshold` | `float` | 20 |  | > 0 overrides the rule set's thresholds.challenge (step-up band) |

### `IngressCommand`

Enable/disable a service's Kafka ingress (topology switching without restarts). On enable the consumer seeks to the end of the topic, so a new run never processes an old backlog.

| Field | Type | # | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `kafka_enabled` | `bool` | 1 |  |

## Example

```yaml
scoring:
  budget_ms: 100
  feature_deadline_ms: 30
  model_deadline_ms: 80
  on_deadline: FALLBACK_RULES
  feature_lookup_delay: { uniform: { min_ms: 2, max_ms: 8 } }
model_server:
  service_time: { uniform: { min_ms: 30, max_ms: 100 } }
  workers: 8
  max_batch: 16
  max_queue_delay_us: 2000
```
